description.en: A bright café study room: bar counter, scattered round tables, a window-side long desk, and a quiet nook.
description.zh: 明亮轻松的咖啡馆自习室：吧台、散座小圆桌、窗边长桌与安静角。

description.en: High-density silent study grid with a tutoring corner and a cheer wall — built for finals week.
description.zh: 高密度静音自习格子间，配答疑角与加油墙，为考试周冲刺而生。

description.en: A compact reading hall: silent tables in the north hall, a discussion corner with a wall whiteboard, and a lobby + lounge in the south.
description.zh: 紧凑的阅览室：北侧安静阅览厅（四人桌行列式）、东角讨论区（白板上墙）、南侧门厅与休闲沙发区。

description.en: A dark, cozy late-night hall: warm lamplight rugs, scattered solo desks, and a midnight diner corner.
description.zh: 深蓝夜色中的深夜自习室：暖光地毯、散点小书桌与深夜食堂角。

description.en: An open welcome hall with a ring of chat tables, a central info desk, and a quiet corner.
description.zh: 开放式迎新大厅：环形交流桌、中央咨询台与一处安静角，轻松开场。
